{{Top|leg}}
A '''dimensional drive''' was a rudimentary faster than light propulsion system that was invented and used by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] in the time before the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].

==History==
This type of propulsion system worked by rippling space-time such that faster than light travel could be achieved. Interstellar ships that made use of a dimensional drive were rather slow when compared to those that would later use [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]]. Due to this fact, crews were placed in [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]] through the process of [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbonite freezing]] to accommodate for trips that could last decades or even centuries. This technology was used by [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to colonize planets like [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and those in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].
